skill.epicfight_awaken.wr_skill.stamina_.en: [Battle Breath] §f Whenever you successfully use a dodge counter or defensive counter to dodge an enemy attack, you immediately recover a small amount of stamina and begin restoring stamina
skill.epicfight_awaken.wr_skill.stamina_.zh: [战斗呼吸] §f 每当你成功使用闪避反击或者防御反击闪避敌人攻击，立即恢复少量耐力并开始恢复耐力

skill.epicfight_awaken.wr_skill.guard_co.en: [Turning The Tide] §f Each time you successfully parry an enemy's attack, your next defensive counter deals 20% more damage for 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 100%
skill.epicfight_awaken.wr_skill.guard_co.zh: [逆转攻势] §f 每当你成功招架敌人的攻击，3秒内使你的下一次防御反击伤害提升20%，最多提升100%

skill.epicfight_awaken.thunder_punishmen.en:
Press [%s + %s] to release

Strike lightning on up to 10 targets within a 16-block radius

Deal [5 + 8%% of Max Health + 300%% of ATK] damage

Damage is doubled if the target has less than 25%% health remaining

Each enemy killed with this skill reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds
skill.epicfight_awaken.thunder_punishmen.zh:
按下[%s + %s]释放

对半径16格内最多10名目标释放雷击

造成[5 + 最大生命值8%% + 攻击力300%%]的伤害

如果目标的生命值低于25%%则伤害翻倍

每使用技能击杀一名敌人，冷却时间缩短10秒

skill.epicfight_awaken.indestructible.to.en:
Whenever your health decreases, gain damage absorption equal to
[2 + 5% of Max Health].
If health is below 50%, the effect is doubled.
skill.epicfight_awaken.indestructible.to.zh:
每当你生命值降低时，获得
[2 + 最大生命值5%]
的伤害吸收量。
如果生命值低于50%，效果翻倍

skill.epicfight_awaken.focused_strike.to.en: When an attack successfully hits an enemy, gain a stack of a buff that increases attack speed by %s%% for %s seconds, stacking up to %s times.
skill.epicfight_awaken.focused_strike.to.zh: 攻击成功命中敌人时，获得一层攻击速度提升%s%%的增益，持续%s秒，最多叠加%s层

skill.epicfight_awaken.rhythmic_enduranc.en: Every 10 seconds, toggle between %s and %s stamina regeneration rate.
skill.epicfight_awaken.rhythmic_enduranc.zh: 每10秒，使自身在耐力回复速度%s和%s之间切换

skill.epicfight_awaken.vulnerability_str.en: During an enemy's attack wind-up, increase damage dealt to them by %s%% and impact by %s%%.
skill.epicfight_awaken.vulnerability_str.zh: 在敌人攻击前摇时，对其造成的伤害增加%s%%，冲击力增加%s%%

skill.epicfight_awaken.revitalize.toolti.en:
Upon entering any stun state, immediately begin regenerating stamina.
If in a broken state, gain a brief Resistance effect at level 2.
skill.epicfight_awaken.revitalize.toolti.zh:
进入任意硬直状态时，立即开始回复耐力。
如果处于破防状态，获得短暂的抗性提升2效果

skill.epicfight_awaken.unyielding_will.t.en: When about to take fatal damage, negate that damage, restore 40% of your health, and gain a brief Resistance effect at level 4.
skill.epicfight_awaken.unyielding_will.t.zh: 即将受到致命伤害时减免当次伤害，并回复自身40%的生命值、获得短暂的抗性提升4效果
